## What lives here
Accounts, sessions, workspaces (each one a Mistral API key), roles and permissions, the route policy, workspace data scoping and the per-workspace workflow workers.

## Conventions
The route policy table (`permissions.py`) is deny-by-default. Platform admins are separate from users. Sessions are httpOnly cookies. Scoped models are registered in `setup.py`.

## Entry points
`middleware.py` (request auth), `permissions.py` (policy), `scoping.py`, `workers.py`, and `routes/auth.py` / `routes/admin.py`.
